method: git archive --format=tar <commit> | ssh expanse tar -x -C <export>; sha256 of every member of the local git archive stream against sha256 of every regular file of the export (os.walk, lstat), and each file mode against the mode git records (git ls-tree: 100644 -> 0644, 100755 -> 0755; the archive stream carries git's default tar.umask 0002, i.e. 0664/0775)
